inputs.label: one or more umr_id positional args

automation: manual/on-demand CLI, callable by generate_pm_report_v3.py or any cron; no scheduled cron wiring added by this task
permissions: server-local shell execution only; read-only against the one live superboss-register.sqlite (umr_tasks table) and read-only against TASKS_DIR/*/task.yaml; never writes; no tenant/org scoping applicable

metadata.purpose: Owner standing order 2026-08-07: no manual AI-judged completion percentages anywhere, ever. Computes a real, reproducible percent-completion for any given umr_id using 5 fixed deterministic rules over real umr_tasks columns (status/ts_completed/ts_dispatched/outputs_json) and real task.yaml completed_steps/remaining_steps lists -- never AI estimation. Unresolvable cases emit percent:null with a real, specific reason string instead of guessing.
reused_from: scripts/superboss-register.py (resolve_superboss_db_path()/_connect()/init_db_silent(), imported not reimplemented, via the same in-process importlib load convention agent_work_briefing.py/resource_governor.py already use)
scripts/backfill_phase_self_report.py (yaml.safe_load() task.yaml read pattern, reused not reimplemented)
scripts/resource_governor.py (_recorded_new_task_ids_for_identity()'s own outputs_json.new_task_id convention, reused not reimplemented)
metadata.known_honest_limitation: task.yaml lookup checks only outputs_json.new_task_id and task_identity as TASKS_DIR entry names -- a row whose real dispatched task dir is named neither (a historical/legacy dispatch shape) falls through to the unresolved rule with a real reason string rather than guessing a match.
metadata.real_test_evidence: Run live against the 5 UMR ids required by UMR-20260807-033052-f756's own SPEC: UMR-20260806-135632-329e -> 100 (rule1), UMR-20260806-140841-46d1 -> 100 (rule1), UMR-20260806-141055-1fec -> 17 (rule2, completed but ts_completed NULL so rule1 didn't fire, real task.yaml resolved it), UMR-20260806-171945-5767 -> 33 (rule2, failed status but a real task.yaml showed genuine progress), UMR-20260807-024922-f432 -> 80 (rule5, running with real task.yaml). Full output + a 13-scenario standalone test (test_umr_completion_percentage.py, covers the null/unresolved path none of the 5 live rows happened to hit) committed alongside.
